title: OptiDate
description: OptiDate- Performance-First. Visual-Ready. OptiDate is a lightweight, high-performance optimization modpack.
body:
OptiDate
Performance-First. Visual-Ready.
OptiDate is a lightweight, high-performance optimization modpack designed to give you the smoothest Minecraft experience possible without sacrificing the "vanilla" feel. Built on the modern Fabric/Quilt loader, it serves as a powerful, up-to-date alternative to OptiFine.
![Vanilla vs OptiDate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6c972926d472fae2823902d99abc01aadd58043.png)
🚀 Key Features:
Maximum FPS: Utilizing industry-standard performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight to squeeze every frame out of your hardware.
Ultra-Fast Loading: Optimized startup times and world generation so you can get into the game instantly.
Shader Support: Full Iris compatibility allows you to run your favorite shaders with significantly better performance than traditional methods.
OptiFine Parity: Includes features like zoom.!
Clean & Stable: No bloatware or game-changing mechanics—just pure, raw optimization.
Whether you're playing on a high-end rig or a "potato" laptop, OptiDate ensures your game stays fluid, responsive, and looking great.
Sodium, Zoomify etc.
